title: ID0421362-DC/Si-D/NL/ [MP / R2 170001542] Live Linux Image required
description:
Reported Issue: Live Linux Image required
Solution: Booted charger with the help of external Keyboard

additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
We prepared the USB Live Linux stick and set the router password to
admin01
, then proceeded with the configuration restore process.
During the restore attempt, we initially encountered a
"No Bootable Device"
error. To investigate further, we performed an IP scan using MobaXterm and noticed that the PLC, Linux, and Logo IPs were not reachable. Upon checking, we confirmed that all devices were powered on, but there were no blinking LEDs on the LAN cables connected to those devices.
We replaced the LAN cables, tried multiple reboots, connected the Live Linux USB stick to different USB ports on the Linux device, and navigated the boot menu using a USB keyboard—but each time, the system continued to show the same
"No Bootable Device"
error.

additional_info.subject: Note to L3
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
Seems issue related to the PLC or its communication module.
Problem Description:
Unable to restore configuration – system displays “No Bootable Device Found”.
Action Performed (L2):
Please refer to the below note for steps taken.
Charger Software Version:
4.0.11
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further support is required to successfully restore the configuration.
Action Required by HQ:
Further support to RC team for the configuration restore process.
